dataClusters.label: Asset Groups
dataClusters.desc: Define your investable universe. Reusable snapshots of market data across equities, crypto, ETFs, forex and global indices — every backtest reproducible.

strategies.label: Strategies
strategies.desc: Write strategies as Python functions in the in-app editor — or describe them in English and let Fintelligent generate the code, parameters, and ranges.

fitness.label: Fitness
fitness.desc: Compose objective functions from 20+ metrics — Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, max drawdown — and reuse them across studies.

studies.label: Studies
studies.desc: Launch thousands of trials in parallel. Bayesian optimization focuses search on promising regions; results validated on train, val, and out-of-sample windows.

portfolios.label: Portfolios
portfolios.desc: Browse ranked portfolios, full equity curves, parameter importance, and trade-level drill-down. Export PDF reports on demand.

liveAgents.label: Live Trading
liveAgents.desc: Promote validated portfolios to live operations that trade through your connected brokerage. Monitor positions and P&L. One click to pause or stop.

features.title: Built for
features.description: Stop assembling stacks. Fintela delivers institutional-grade infrastructure as a product — opinionated where it matters, flexible where it counts.

crossMarket.title: Cross-market by design
crossMarket.description: A single strategy engine works across crypto, U.S. equities, S&P indices, ETFs, forex and global markets. One mental model, every asset class.

screener.title: Institutional-grade screener
screener.description: Build your investable universe with a Finviz-grade screener: descriptive, fundamental and technical filters as guided dropdowns with a live match count — no guessing units, scales or ranges. Themes and sub-themes classify every ticker into exotic sectors automatically.

laboratory.title: One lab for your whole workflow
laboratory.description: Strategies, fitness functions, risk managers and data pipelines — authored side by side in a single workbench, with a live Python notebook on a per-session cloud kernel and curated in-app market data. Prototype in a cell, compile it straight into a shippable resource, and publish to or fork from a cross-organization catalog.

dataPipelines.title: Data pipelines
dataPipelines.description: Wire any source — built-in feeds, your own external APIs, or your own database behind an HTTPS endpoint — into strategies, fitness and risk managers as reusable, versioned pipelines. Graph-aware validation runs your exact wiring before you save. No config files, no glue code.

dataLab.title: Know the shape of every ingredient
dataLab.description: Every data source you can feed a strategy — prices, fundamentals, hierarchical groupings, default clusters, basket holdings — shows its exact shape (table, dictionary, membership set or record), how to index it in code, and a live sample. Configure and preview the non-price objects too, so nothing is a black box before you wire it in.

metaStrategies.title: Meta-strategies on baskets
metaStrategies.description: Build portfolios of portfolios. A asset group can feed on your graduated baskets — each basket's equity curve scores exactly like a ticker — so you can optimize how capital is allocated across your own portfolios. Strategies can also read basket holdings over time as a signal. Meta-portfolios graduate and trade live like any other strategy.

allocation.title: Advanced portfolio allocation
allocation.description: Weight your basket's members with more than equal weight. A premium catalog — risk parity from the full covariance matrix, volatility targeting, and momentum or mean-reversion tilts by any metric — applies identically in backtest and live. Basic methods stay free; advanced ones unlock per basket with Fintela tokens.

attribution.title: See what's driving your basket
attribution.description: The Ideas panel attributes your basket's return to each name and sector from its own backtested trades — so you can see, for instance, that one ticker is dragging while the rest compounds. Every insight is one-click testable: re-simulate the basket without a name or sector and see the exact impact, a transient preview that's never traded.

pipeline.title: One unified pipeline
pipeline.description: Data ingestion, strategy code, optimization, backtesting, analytics and live deployment — no exports, no scripts, no glue code.

ai.title: AI that operates the platform
ai.description: Fintelligent doesn’t answer questions — it generates strategy code, launches studies, builds reports, and explains results in plain English.

bayesian.title: Bayesian optimization, native
bayesian.description: Thousands of trials searched intelligently — the engine learns from every run, focusing compute where it matters. Train / validation / OOS by default.

strategyClustering.title: See your distinct strategies
strategyClustering.description: An optimization's top trials are usually the same strategy in disguise. Fintela clusters every trial by the correlation of its equity curve and shows how many genuinely distinct strategies you found — a behavioral map, the representative curve per family, and which family holds your best trial — so you optimize for real diversity, not lucky duplicates.

paramImportances.title: Know which knobs matter
paramImportances.description: Fintela decomposes each optimization with fANOVA and mean-decrease-impurity to reveal the share of performance variance every hyperparameter actually drives — and in which direction. It contrasts train against validation importance to flag the parameters that overfit, with bootstrap confidence intervals on every estimate. Institutional-grade attribution, not a correlation heuristic.

metrics.title: 20+ performance metrics
metrics.description: Full equity curves, parameter importance charts, trade- and scaling-level drill-down (per-scale MAE/MFE, scaling efficiency, partial-success ratio), and side-by-side portfolio comparisons. PDF export for stakeholders.

python.title: Python-first, no setup
python.description: Write strategies as plain Python functions in the in-app editor, with a curated scientific stack — NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, ta, CVXPY — ready to import. Named parameters, typed ranges, version history. Zero local environment.

liveTrading.title: Live long/short trading through your brokerage
liveTrading.description: Promote any backtested portfolio — long-only or long/short — to a live operation. Orders execute through your connected brokerage with real-time order logs and one-click pause.

protectiveExecution.title: Smart execution with built-in protection
protectiveExecution.description: Tune how live orders fill — market or marketable-limit, day or good-till-canceled — at the basket, strategy, or order level. Every position can arm an automatic protective exit (stop, stop-limit, or trailing stop) the moment a buy fills.

cloud.title: Cloud-native, zero install
cloud.description: Fully browser-based, enterprise-grade reliability. Your team, your data, your strategies — accessible securely from anywhere.

provenance.title: Cryptographic provenance
provenance.description: Strategies and configurations are hashed and time-stamped, ensuring authorship and tamper-proof auditability across the team.

privacy.title: Private by default, shared on your terms
privacy.description: Keep every strategy, study and portfolio private, then share exactly what you choose — with specific colleagues or your whole organization. Share a results-only dashboard that shows your performance while keeping your code and hyperparameters hidden.

quantum.title: Search smarter with a
quantum.description: Wrap your hyperparameter search in a quantum optimization algorithm, run on an emulated quantum computer. Your simulations and fitness stay classical and unchanged — only the search itself goes quantum.

qaoa.title: QAOA optimization
qaoa.desc: We recast your search space as a QUBO and let the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm — on a quantum-circuit simulator — decide where to look next.

qkernel.title: Quantum-kernel Bayesian search
qkernel.desc: A Gaussian-process search whose kernel is measured from a quantum feature map, comparing configurations inside a quantum state space.

hardwareReady.title: Emulated today, hardware-ready tomorrow
hardwareReady.desc: Built on PennyLane: the very same study can target real quantum processors — AWS Braket, IBM Quantum — the day you flip the switch.

quantum.note: Experimental. An emulator is a research edge and a bridge to real quantum hardware — it reimagines how the search explores, not how fast it runs.

faq.title: Questions,
faq.description: The fast read on how Fintela works, what it costs, and where it fits.

assetClasses.q: What asset classes does Fintela support?
assetClasses.a: Crypto and currencies, U.S. equities, S&P indices, ETFs, forex, and global markets — all through the same unified strategy engine. Build a strategy once, test it across any cluster you define.

vsBacktesting.q: How is Fintela different from a standard backtesting library?
vsBacktesting.a: Fintela goes beyond backtesting — it unifies asset groups, strategy code, Bayesian parameter optimization, train/validation/OOS evaluation, portfolio analytics, and live deployment via your connected brokerage into a single pipeline. No exports, no scripts, no glue code between tools.

python.q: Do I need to know Python?
python.a: Yes, strategies are Python functions — but Fintelligent can generate them for you. Describe what you want in plain English and the agent writes the code, configures the parameters, and stages the form for your review.

optimization.a: Fintela uses Bayesian optimization, which learns from each trial to focus search on the most promising parameter regions. Every study is evaluated across three time windows — train (in-sample), validation (held-out), and out-of-sample — so robustness is built into the workflow.

seedExport.q: Can I export my strategy's signal?
seedExport.a: Yes. Every trial, basket, and sandbox run exposes its seed — the daily rebalancing signal (date → ticker → position/allocation) the engine used to build the backtest. You can inspect it date by date and download it as JSON (the exact engine input) or CSV, straight from the app.

liveTrading.a: Validated portfolios can be promoted to live operations that execute through your connected brokerage. You see real-time order logs, P&L, and a one-click pause. Multiple operations can run in parallel against different baskets.

security.a: Yes. Strategies and configurations are cryptographically hashed and time-stamped, ensuring authorship verification and tamper-proof auditability. The platform is fully cloud-hosted with enterprise-grade reliability.

poweredBy.q: Who is Fintelligent powered by, and is it safe?
poweredBy.a: Fintelligent runs on DeepSeek V4 (auto-routing between Pro and Flash) with Fintela-managed access — no API key to bring. Every tool call is visible in the chat, and every irreversible action (creating/stopping a study, deploying an operation) requires your explicit confirmation before execution.

speed.q: How fast can I go from idea to live capital?
speed.a: Most teams reach a fully validated, deployable strategy in 3 days — about 10× faster than traditional infrastructure. The bottleneck is the quality of the idea, not the tooling.

finalCta.description: No big payments, no complicated legal terms. The same engine hedge funds use — open to you in minutes.
